The girl was in a house with a window that looked out onto a living person who was watching her. Seeing that person made her afraid to sleep, though the watcher was not necessarily an actual threat. Once exhaustion overcame her, she fell asleep. In the morning, she realized the window itself had changed from how it looked at night: it was no longer transparent. The watcher was gone, and the change in the window was connected to that person, but the clues do not establish the exact mechanism. Frightened by what she saw, she fled.
